decisions.reason: Uncertainty about the adjustable display's market is still high and keeping it listed costs little, so the option remains open.
The pegboard-back variant is a distinct option with unresolved prospects and low ongoing cost, so it is kept open.
Although similar to another quarter-pallet display, its value is not yet disproven and the cost of keeping it is low.
The eighth-pallet format is a separate option whose market acceptance remains uncertain, so it is retained while information accumulates.
The wooden display is less aligned with core paper capabilities but still an option with unresolved potential, so it is kept for now.
The media-specific quarter-pallet display has uncertain niche demand and low keeping cost, so the option is held open.
